meta.title: Modpack Kit
meta.description: (Put these plugins together and it is genuinely good.) A PCL/HMCL-style modpack tool for DSH: bundle DSH plugins with their own config and data into one .dshpack and install them in one go; a bare DSH can install it too. Three strategies: lazy pack (payload included, works offline), download-only (install code only, smallest), hybrid (the strategy follows how each plugin is configured). Per-plugin setup: "plugin preset" or "custom config"; entries are restored item by item, existing local files are not overwritten by default, and suspected credentials become ${REDACTED}. Forced checks: before packing, scan for risky or sensitive content (masked only); high risk pauses for confirmation. Before installing, verify sha256, compatibility and licences. In sync with the market: categories, search, paging, groups and versions follow the plugin market catalog; packing and installing still work without it. Use it as a backup of your plugin combo: move to a new machine, back up or share plugin config. Sources include file and folder pickers, any directory, imported list and links; supports the market AI search. Would love to build a modpack marketplace but not skilled enough; updates are irregular (cluck cluck). Installing the plugin market (dshmarket) is recommended for a better experience. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-modpack-kit
